name: Bokunchi no Kaseifu-san
original_name: ボクん家の家性婦さん
source:
Jun lives with his father. One day, his father goes abroad on business. When Jun comes back home on his departure day, there is a girl standing in front of his house. She is a hired housekeeper, according to her. He doesn't know it, but finds a sheet of paper on the table, "I've hired a housekeeper while I'm away. She'll serve you well...." When he is confused, the doorbell rings. He opens the door and there stand two girls. It seems they are hired as housekeepers as well. "Did he mistakenly hire them? Well, there's no way to ask him...." There is, however, one thing for sure... they are all beautiful. Like this, Jun starts living with three housekeepers....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
淳与父亲共同生活。一天，父亲因工作前往海外。父亲出发当天，淳回到家，发现一名少女站在门前。她自称是受雇前来的管家，淳对此毫不知情，却在桌上发现一张纸：“我不在时雇了一名管家。她会好好服侍你…”淳正困惑时，门铃响起。打开门后，外面又站着两名少女，似乎也都是受雇而来的管家。“难道父亲不小心雇了三个人？可现在也没办法问他…”不过至少有一件事可以确定：她们全都非常美丽。就这样，淳开始与三名管家共同生活…

[摘自ErogeShop]
